**International Copper Study Group Statistical Committee Thirty-Fourth Regular Meeting 6**<sup>**th**</sup> **October 2009, 4.00pm-6.00pm Lisbon, Portugal** 

**ICSG/STAT34/1 (Rev.1)** 

# **Statistical Committee Provisional Agenda** 

## **1. Opening of the Meeting by the Chairperson** 

The Chairman will open the 34<sup>th</sup> regular meeting of the ICSG Statistical Committee. 

## **2. Adoption of the Agenda** 

The Chairman will move to adopt the Provisional Agenda 

## **3. Forecast Comparisons and Accuracy of ICSG Forecast** 

(Background Document ICSG/STAT34/2) 

The ICSG secretariat will present the results of the comparison analysis between previous supply-demand forecasts and actual data. This comparison exercise is an indicative tool to assess the validity of ICSG projections by identifying the main reasons for over/ under estimates for production and usage. ICSG forecasts of production and usage for 2008 will be compared with actual ICSG data results. 

The accuracies of the projections produced by the Study Group are highly dependent on the inputs of the twice yearly forecasts received from each Study Group member country. Therefore member countries should ensure maximum rigor in developing the forecast data provided to the ICSG Secretariat.  Unforeseen factors such as strikes, operational failures or natural disasters, and the ability to adjust for them also have an important impact of the validity of the forecast. 

## **4. Presentation by CRU representative on “Recent trends in copper wirerod markets”** 

## **5. Presentation of ICSG Copper Production and Usage Forecast for 2009/2010 and indicative forecast for 2011** 

(Document ICSG/STAT34/3 - to be released 1 week prior to the meeting) 

A preliminary version of the forecast has been developed by the Secretariat of the ICSG based on the Forecast Surveys submitted by member countries and industry and discussions with industry experts. 

The ICSG secretariat will present the results of the Preliminary Forecast and outline the main assumptions behind it. 

## **6. Forecasting Forum** 

The ICSG secretariat will open the floor for detailed discussions on the forecast results on a country by country basis.  Delegates will be asked to submit any latest data revisions available for their countries or any other information or data they may have on other specific countries. A version of the forecast will be presented simultaneously on the screen allowing for in-situ revisions and instant updates in market balances. In case of amendments to the forecast the staff will endeavour to get a final version of the forecast ready for distribution in the next day. 

## **7. Report on progress in the 2009/2010 ICSG Statistical Activities and Projects Work Program** 

(Background Document ICSG/STAT34/4) 

The secretariat will provide a report on progress in relation to the activities in the approved 2009/2010 Statistics Work Program. 

Delegates are invited to discuss the Work Program and may wis

h to suggest additional topics. 

## **8. ICSG Statistical Press Release** 

(Document ICSG/STAT34/5 - to be made available at the meeting) 

A draft of the press release summarizing the forecast results will be jointly prepared by the secretariat and the Chairman. This document will be distributed at the meeting. Delegates will be invited to analyse it and present their comments or suggestions to the secretariat before its final approval. 

## **9. Other business**
